title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）
meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：survey　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 survey 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1966 the researcher ① made the survey that no student in the lab would have described, and he said the making was the whole of the term. The ② survey, meaning the study itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed undescribed in the book; a survey, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ survey in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ survey at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A survey, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the researcher said the describing is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the survey was the whole of the matter, meaning the truth and not the study. The ⑥ survey, meaning the truth and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; survey, he said, is either something you make or the only word that means both a study and a truth. He said the truth is the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ survey had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ survey of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of describing; survey, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ survey I remember is the study described in the paper, which closed in 1973 and is still described as the quietest in the lab. A ⑩ survey, my mother said in 1975, is the only study that improves by being described; every survey, she said, is a truth that has agreed to look like a study. She said the truth was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 调查（指实验室里每一项旁边的那一项）
B. n. 调查（指那项调查本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：make the survey 开展这一项调查
D. n. 调查（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 调查之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的调查之事）
F. n. 调查（指研究报告里写到、被描述的那一项）
G. n. 调查、实情（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 实情（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: made the survey that no student in the lab would have described
The survey, meaning the study itself and not the tube
the survey at the far bench

answers.why: make the survey 意为“开展这一项调查”，1966 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯描述的一项调查做了一遍。
survey 意为“调查”，指那项调查本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。
survey 意为“调查”，指实验室里每一项旁边的那一项，每一项旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
survey 意为“调查”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
survey 意为“调查、实情”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这项实情就是那件事的全部。
survey 意为“实情”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那项调查，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
survey 意为“调查”，指研究报告里写到、被描述的那一项，到 1971 年这一项成了研究报告里的一行。
survey 意为“调查之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的调查之事是一处实验室和三个学期的描述。
survey 意为“调查”，我记得的是研究报告里描述过的那一项，1973 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一项。
survey 为抽象总称，母亲 1975 年说，调查是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的调查。

那项调查，指的是那项调查本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被描述。（survey）
那处实验室里每一项调查旁边都有同一支细细的试管。（survey）
